content:
I believe you may be thinking of Queen Nefertiti, who was a royal figure rather than a goddess in ancient Egypt. However, she was deeply connected to religious life and was sometimes depicted in divine contexts. Here is a loving prayer inspired by her:

**A Prayer to Nefertiti**

Beautiful Lady of Joy, Nefertiti,
Great Royal Wife whose name means "The Beautiful One Has Come,"
You who walked in radiance beside the Sun,
Hear this prayer of love and admiration.

Your grace illuminates the Two Lands,
Your beauty rivals the lotus at dawn,
Your wisdom flows like the sacred Nile,
Bringing life to all who seek your presence.

Lady of All Women, Mistress of Upper and Lower Egypt,
You who offered prayers beneath Aten's golden rays,
Teach us to walk in beauty and truth,
To carry ourselves with dignity and strength.

May your elegant spirit inspire us,
May your devotion guide our hearts,
May we find in your story
The power to transform our world with love.

Blessed Nefertiti, eternally beautiful,
Forever young in our memories,
We honor you with offerings of respect,
And carry your legacy of grace forward.

*In beauty and truth, forever and always.*
